RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 13, 2003/Sravana 22, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
94
Pending power projects of UP
†*321. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether any new power project of
the State of Uttar Pradesh is pending with
the Central Government for approval; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Delhi Co-operative Societies Bill
*322. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal from the Delhi Government for
enactment of the Delhi Co-operative
Societies Bill;
(b) if so, the details thereof including its
objects;
(c) when the proposal togetherwith the
text of the proposed Bill was received; and
(d) by when the proposal is likely to be
cleared by Government?
Diversion of arms and ammunition
*323. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that arms and
ammunition of the Indian army is being
diverted to terrorist outfits by our own
paramilitary forces; and
(b) whether any inquiry has been
conducted into this affair; if so, the details
thereof?
Diamond-mines
†*324. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the diamond-mines in
the country; and
(b) the status of diamond-mines in the
State of Chhattisgarh?
Poverty alleviation schemes
†*325. SHRI ABHAY KANT
PRASAD: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the World Bank has
sanctioned funds for poverty alleviation
schemes in the rural areas;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

95
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
(c) the State-wise details of the
proposals pending  with Government in this
regard; and
(d) the action so far taken by
Government in this regard?
Savings under SJGSY
†*326. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether women are being
encouraged to cultivate  habit  of savings
under  Swarn Jayanti Gram Swarojgar
Yojana;
(b) if so, whether Government are also
contributing any amount as incentive to the
amount of savings done under this scheme;
and
(c) if so, the district-wise details in respect
of Bihar during the financial year 2001-2002?
Cross-border terrorism
*327. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any report from the Intelligence authorities
warning that cross-border terrorism and
infiltration from Pakistan will pick-up by
August-September this year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the pre-emptive steps being taken/
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Fortifying  army camps and
installations in J&K
*328. PROF. M. SANKARALINGAM :
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an order  has
been issued to the effect that army  camps
and other army installations in Jammu and
Kashmir should be fortified with barbed
wire fencing;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of attacks on army camps
and installations in Jammu and Kashmir by
Pak militants during the last six months?
Introduction of hydrogen as an
alternative fuel
*329. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
high  powered  Committee and given it six
weeks to finalise a 'Road map' for the
introduction of hydrogen as an alternative
fuel in the country;
(b) if so, the comparative advantages of
developing hydrogen as an energy source;
and
(c) the estimated cost of doing this?
Fencing of Rajouri-Poonch sector
*330.  SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether 280 kilometres Line of
Control in the woods of Rajouri-Poonch
sector has been fenced; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

96
(b) if not, when the work is likely to be
taken up and completed to stop infiltration
of Pak ultras into India?
Anti-terrorist cell in Karnataka
*331. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka has anti-terrorist
special cell to deal with any unprecedented
situation in the State; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
whether Government propose to give any
direction to set up such cell in the State?
Nirmal Gram Puraskar scheme
†*332. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
an incentive scheme named as "Nirmal
Gram Puraskar" with a view to encourage
cleanliness in rural areas;

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 13, 2003/Sravana 22, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional Energy
Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—155
Increasing the production capacity of
coal washeries
†2388. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to refer to reply to Unstarred Question
1028 given in the Rajya Sabha on
30th July, 2002 and state:
(a) whether the production capacity of
coal washeries is proposed to be increased
further in the country; and
(b) if so, the future plan of Government
in this regard?
Implementation of Supreme Court's
directions by CIL
2389. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to refer to
reply to Unstarred Question 4184 given in
the Rajya Sabha on the 30th April, 2003
and state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court on the
application filed before it for modification
of its orders dated 29th April, 2002,
passed an order on 13th January, 2003;
if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether the CIL complied with the
directions of the Supreme Court order
dated 29th April, 2002; and
522
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Coal mining outside State boundaries
2390. SHRI VAYALAR RAVI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Centre has decided to
allow State public sector undertakings to
take up coal mining outside their State
boundaries and sell it in the open market
anywhere; and
(b) if so, whether the States having no
substantial coal reserves can actually set
up their own coal producing entities and
start operation in coal rich States such as
Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal?
Payment of royalty to States
2391. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI :
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state :
(a) whether it is  a fact that Central
Government has taken over mineral
resources of States like Madhya Pradesh,
Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bihar, Orissa, etc.
(b) whether Government has received
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

523
requests from these States  for payment of
ad valorem royalty and if so, action taken
thereon;
(c) whether Government have revised
the coal royalties after  1994; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Measures to check bird hits around
IAF bases
2392. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have approved
a plan for cleaning environment in the cities
having Indian Air Force bases to reduce the
loss of aircraft due to bird hits; and
(b) if so, the bases where this cleaning
is proposed to be undertaken?
Showcasing of helicopters by HAL
2393. SHRI PREM CHAND
GUPTA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that HAL made
history for Indians by displaying a new
generation desi-aircraft for the first time on
western soil at the Paris Air Show in June
this year;
(b) whether the multi-role all whether
and terrain Advanced Light Helicopter
(ALH), Dhruv won the hearts of many
customers with its vary  attractive price
tag $5.5 million; and
(c) if so, what are the marketing
proposals of this new helicopter in the
export market?
Function halls in Secunderabad
cantonment
2394. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) how many function halls are there in
the Secunderabad cantonment area on lease;
(b) how much land each one of them
has occupied; and
(c) how much land has been given to
other persons on lease for running hotels
etc. in the cantonment areas?
Order to vacate huts to poor families of
Secunderabad cantonment
2395. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several poor
families in Secunderabad cantonment area
are serving military personnel by washing/
cleaning military houses and providing other
household services and assisting in menial
jobs for the last 4 or 5 decades; and
(b) if so, the reasons for giving them
notices to vacate their huts and exchange
land?
Positioning an eye in the sky
2396. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
position "An eye in the sky" tucked into
152 metre long helium based balloon above
the country's border; and
(b) if so, how will this be useful to
augment border surveillance and track
missiles?

524

Mauritius for surveillance of
EEZ of Mauritius

Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have
formalised an agreement with Mauritian for
the surveillance of exclusive economic zone
of Mauritius in Indian ocean by the Indian
Navy;
(b) whether this calls for continued
regular deployment of Indian Naval vessels
and personnel in the Mauritian waters;
(c) whether our navy is fully stretched
